records.title: The Origins

records.potential: Prestige series • historical novels • education • museum • documentary • soundtrack
records.audience: Publishers, studios, museums, educators, beauty-industry partners, cultural institutions, documentary teams, and community-enterprise programs.

Juneteenth Forever supplies the official freedom score while Alma Knight Carter opens the first complete historical family-enterprise novel.
records.canon_guardrail: Alma Knight Carter is fictional. She is not the true founder of Melanin Magic or Locticians, her fictional formulas are not products sold today, shared surnames do not prove biological lineage, and mutual aid never becomes Carter household capital.

records.title: The Carter–Knight Bloodline

records.potential: Prestige series • books • archive podcast • museum • education
records.audience: Studios, publishers, museums, educators, cultural partners, and premium transmedia producers.
story_engines: The Bible, photograph, ledger, letter, funeral program, and DNA match reveal one layer at a time.
Elders carry oral truth; adult children carry damage; grandchildren test every version against the archive.
Juneteenth Forever and Embrace Your Roots provide the historical anthology spine without reducing the family to victimhood.
records.canon_guardrail: This shared continuity is a later canon layer. It does not pretend the original Willie & Maybelle Bible always contained the Carter–Knight crossover.

records.title: Willie & Maybelle Jenkins

records.audience: Grown-folks audiences, producers, theater partners, publishers, lifestyle brands, and cultural institutions.

Children, grandchildren, church friends, ex-lovers, and old fools turn one marriage into a multigenerational ensemble.
records.canon_guardrail: Jenkins remains the public household identity. Carter-era records and the surname discrepancy stay versioned in the canon ledger until formally reconciled.

records.title: Two Damn Fools
